summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Marsol ERP Settings page and Finance page updates. Backend API tests: 30/30 passed (100%). Frontend UI tests: Settings page with 4 tabs (Paketlər, Layihələr, Xüsusi sahələr, İstifadəçilər) working correctly. Finance page had a runtime error which was fixed. All CRUD operations for packages, projects, custom fields, users, incomes, and expenses are functional.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: SelectItem with empty string value causing runtime error 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string'

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/settings/custom-fields creates select field with options
Backend: POST /api/finance/incomes creates income with auto-calculated debt
Backend: PUT /api/finance/incomes/{id} updates income and recalculates debt
Backend: GET /api/options/companies returns companies for dropdown
Frontend: Login with test credentials works
Frontend: Settings page loads at /settings route
Frontend: Settings page has 4 tabs (Paketlər, Layihələr, Xüsusi sahələr, İstifadəçilər)
Frontend: Packages tab shows form and list of packages
Frontend: Projects tab shows form and list of projects
Frontend: Custom Fields tab shows add button and list
Frontend: Custom field modal opens with module/type selection
Frontend: Users tab shows user table with roles
Frontend: User modal opens with role selection (Admin, Menecer, İstifadəçi, Baxıcı)
Frontend: Finance page loads with summary cards
Frontend: Finance page shows Gəlir and Xərc buttons
Frontend: Income modal has company dropdown
Frontend: Expense modal opens correctly (after fix)
Frontend: Finance tabs (İcmal, Gəlirlər, Xərclər) work
Frontend: Sidebar shows Tənzimləmələr menu item

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Settings page functionality (Packages, Projects, Custom Fields, Users CRUD) and Finance page (Incomes, Expenses CRUD) are working. Fixed a runtime error in Finance.jsx where SelectItem had empty string value. Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_settings_finance.py with 30 passing tests.

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Finance page Expenses tab causing runtime error
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In Finance.jsx line 487, SelectItem component had value="" (empty string) which is not allowed by Radix UI Select component
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed value="" to value="none" and updated onValueChange handler to convert 'none' back to empty string
